gui.backup.alert_never: No successful database backup has ever been recorded.
gui.backup.alert_overdue: The last successful database backup was on {when}. A backup is overdue.
gui.backup.reason_drive_missing: The backup flash drive was not found at the last attempt. Connect it to the database PC; the backup will then run automatically.
gui.backup.reason_failed: The last backup attempt failed. Check the backup log on the database PC.
gui.backup.reason_none: No recent backup attempt was recorded. Check that the scheduled backup task is running on the database PC.
